Strawberry Xocai Chocolate Protein Shake
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Tuesday, September 6, 2011 - 10:32am

Ingredients




8 oz          1% Organic Milk
1 scoop 	Sugar-free Strawberry Whey Protein Powder
1 oz 	        Xocai Activ Powder

Preparation

1 Blend milk with protein powder, Pour into 12-16 oz. glass and add Activ. Stir. Serves 1

About

Give your daily morning protein shake a delicious kick with Strawberries and Dark Chocolate!
